pages.text: This modpack includes a datapack that increases difficulty in several ways. It's recommended to play on $(item)Normal$() for your first playthrough, as $(item)Hard$() will truly test your skills.$(br2)In particular, $(item)Hardcore$() is to be feared. It won't be possible without either extensive knowledge or great preparation.

If you know what you're doing and want a greater challenge without just increasing stats, that can be done as well. The rest of the pages in this chapter will describe $(thing)custom challenge modes$() and provide buttons to enable or disable them.$(br2)Challenges cannot be enabled while the Wither Storm is alive, but they can be disabled at any time. You can simultaneously activate as many of them as you want.

pages.title: Silent Storm
pages.text: The Wither Storm makes no ambient noises and doesn't play music. Its boss bar will not be visible underground. Certain attacks will still make sounds.$(br2)$(c:/trigger Challenge set 1)Click to Enable/Disable$()

pages.title: Diggy Diggy Hole
pages.text: The Wither Storm has no cooldown between digging attacks.$(br2)$(c:/trigger Challenge set 2)Click to Enable/Disable$()

pages.title: Incuritis
pages.text: All players are permanently infected with Wither Sickness while the Wither Storm is alive. Golden Apple Stew will still restore health.$(br2)$(c:/trigger Challenge set 3)Click to Enable/Disable$()

pages.title: Draconic Temperament
pages.text: The Wither Storm will not get distracted, its tractor beams are more aggressive and powerful, and all custom skull attacks use powerful and fast blue skulls.$(br2)$(c:/trigger Challenge set 4)Click to Enable/Disable$()

pages.title: Withering Apocalypse
pages.text: All mobs that can be sickened are instantly converted into powerful sickened variants.$(br2)$(c:/trigger Challenge set 5)Click to Enable/Disable$()
